title: The Interface
lead: Cachly is organized into five tabs along the bottom of the screen. Knowing what lives where makes everything else in this guide easier to follow.

sections.heading: Opening Cachly from Other Apps and Links
sections.text: Cachly registers the cachly:// URL scheme, so any app that can open a link — Shortcuts, Notes, Reminders, a spreadsheet, an NFC-tag automation, a launcher app or another geocaching tool — can launch Cachly or jump straight to a cache, a trackable, a user, a list or a search. Since Cachly 8.2.6 ordinary web links to www.cachly.com carrying the same parameters open Cachly too, which makes them safe to share: a friend without Cachly simply lands on the website. Link What it opens cachly:// Opens Cachly (or brings it to the front) exactly where you left it. Nothing else happens. cachly://gccode=GC18 https://www.cachly.com/?gccode=GC18 The cache page for that GC code, as a card over whatever is on screen. Case doesn’t matter. cachly://tbcode=TB1234 https://www.cachly.com/?tbcode=TB1234 That trackable on the Trackables tab. A TB reference code or a tracking number both work. cachly://user=username https://www.cachly.com/?user=username That user’s profile on the More tab. Use a geocaching.com username, a PR reference code, or me for your own profile. cachly://list=BM123 https://www.cachly.com/?list=BM123 That bookmark or shared list on the Lists tab, by its BM reference code. cachly://search=Golden%20Gate%20Park https://www.cachly.com/?search=Golden%20Gate%20Park The Live tab, with the text run through the map’s search bar exactly as if you had typed it — a place name, an address, a GC code or a q: query. Write spaces as %20 . cachly://coordinates=47.6209,-122.3510 https://www.cachly.com/?coordinates=47.6209,-122.3510 The Live tab, searched at those coordinates (latitude, longitude in decimal degrees). When you open a cache this way, Cachly first looks for it in your offline lists . If it finds a saved copy, that copy opens instantly and works without a connection. Otherwise Cachly fetches the cache live from geocaching.com, so you need to be online and the GC code has to exist. Swipe the card down or tap Done to return to where you were. ⓘ You must be signed in to geocaching.com for these links to do anything; before sign-in they simply open the app. Only GC codes are accepted for gccode and only BM codes for list — Adventure Lab and other identifiers are ignored. A link should carry one parameter; if it carries several, Cachly acts on the first one in the order of the table above. How web links behave A www.cachly.com link opens in Cachly when it is tapped in another app — Messages, Mail, Notes, a forum post, a calendar entry — and carries one of the parameters above. A plain https://www.cachly.com link always opens the website. Typing the address into Safari, or tapping the link while you are already browsing cachly.com, stays in Safari; in that case touch and hold the link and choose Open in Cachly . iOS remembers that choice for future links. Example: a Shortcut that opens a cache In the Shortcuts app, create a new shortcut and add the Open URLs action. Enter cachly://gccode= followed by the GC code (or an Ask Each Time variable so the shortcut prompts you for the code). Run it from the Shortcuts widget, Siri, the Action button, or an NFC tag automation. A tag on your geocaching bag could open the cache you’re currently working on. 💡 You don’t need the URL scheme for ordinary geocaching.com or coord.info links: copy one and Cachly offers to open the cache the next time it comes to the front (see Detect Geocache Links ), or paste it into the Live tab search field . The cachly:// scheme is for automation, where there is no web link to copy.

Cachly is organized into five tabs along the bottom of the screen. Knowing what lives where makes everything else in this guide easier to follow.

The Five Tabs

TabWhat you’ll find
LiveThe map and list of caches around you. The hub of day-to-day caching. See The Map.
ListsThree segments: Offline lists of caches downloaded to your device, your Online geocaching.com bookmark lists, and Trips for planning a route of caches. See Lists & Offline Lists and CarPlay.

TrackablesTravel Bugs and geocoins in your inventory and that you own. See Trackables.
MoreYour profile, settings, import/export, downloads, backups and utilities.

Inside the More Tab

The More tab is where less-frequent but powerful tools live. At the top is your profile row — tap it for your finds, hides, stats, souvenirs and favorites (Profile & Social). Below it, everything the More tab offers, grouped as it appears in the app:

iPad

On iPad, Cachly runs full-screen with the same interface as on iPhone, giving the map, lists and cache details more room, and it works alongside other apps with iPadOS multitasking. See iPad.

Opening Cachly from Other Apps and Links

Cachly registers the cachly:// URL scheme, so any app that can open a link — Shortcuts, Notes, Reminders, a spreadsheet, an NFC-tag automation, a launcher app or another geocaching tool — can launch Cachly or jump straight to a cache, a trackable, a user, a list or a search. Since Cachly 8.2.6 ordinary web links to www.cachly.com carrying the same parameters open Cachly too, which makes them safe to share: a friend without Cachly simply lands on the website.

LinkWhat it opens
cachly://Opens Cachly (or brings it to the front) exactly where you left it. Nothing else happens.
cachly://gccode=GC18
https://www.cachly.com/?gccode=GC18		The cache page for that GC code, as a card over whatever is on screen. Case doesn’t matter.
cachly://tbcode=TB1234
https://www.cachly.com/?tbcode=TB1234		That trackable on the Trackables tab. A TB reference code or a tracking number both work.
cachly://user=username
https://www.cachly.com/?user=username		That user’s profile on the More tab. Use a geocaching.com username, a PR reference code, or me for your own profile.
cachly://list=BM123
https://www.cachly.com/?list=BM123		That bookmark or shared list on the Lists tab, by its BM reference code.
cachly://search=Golden%20Gate%20Park
https://www.cachly.com/?search=Golden%20Gate%20Park		The Live tab, with the text run through the map’s search bar exactly as if you had typed it — a place name, an address, a GC code or a q: query. Write spaces as %20.
cachly://coordinates=47.6209,-122.3510
https://www.cachly.com/?coordinates=47.6209,-122.3510		The Live tab, searched at those coordinates (latitude, longitude in decimal degrees).

When you open a cache this way, Cachly first looks for it in your offline lists. If it finds a saved copy, that copy opens instantly and works without a connection. Otherwise Cachly fetches the cache live from geocaching.com, so you need to be online and the GC code has to exist. Swipe the card down or tap Done to return to where you were.

ⓘ
You must be signed in to geocaching.com for these links to do anything; before sign-in they simply open the app. Only GC codes are accepted for gccode and only BM codes for list — Adventure Lab and other identifiers are ignored. A link should carry one parameter; if it carries several, Cachly acts on the first one in the order of the table above.

How web links behave

A www.cachly.com link opens in Cachly when it is tapped in another app — Messages, Mail, Notes, a forum post, a calendar entry — and carries one of the parameters above. A plain https://www.cachly.com link always opens the website. Typing the address into Safari, or tapping the link while you are already browsing cachly.com, stays in Safari; in that case touch and hold the link and choose Open in Cachly. iOS remembers that choice for future links.

Example: a Shortcut that opens a cache

  1. In the Shortcuts app, create a new shortcut and add the Open URLs action.
  2. Enter cachly://gccode= followed by the GC code (or an Ask Each Time variable so the shortcut prompts you for the code).
  3. Run it from the Shortcuts widget, Siri, the Action button, or an NFC tag automation. A tag on your geocaching bag could open the cache you’re currently working on.
💡
You don’t need the URL scheme for ordinary geocaching.com or coord.info links: copy one and Cachly offers to open the cache the next time it comes to the front (see Detect Geocache Links), or paste it into the Live tab search field. The cachly:// scheme is for automation, where there is no web link to copy.
